name: Whipstock Durance
description: Stand still like a hawk on its perch with the thong draped to cover the flanks.

name: Rumble Whiptail
description: Fling both arms wide as the cast leaves so the thong opens like a wing across the foe.

name: Granite Lash
description: Glide in a long low line toward the foe with the thong held ready behind.

name: Snap Durance
description: Close the tip around a wrist like a talon and clench with a pulse of qi.

name: Charter Whipheel
description: Crack the thong high overhead so the report pins the foe's eyes upward for a moment.

name: Popperdurance
description: Bank the thong in a tight turn that sheds a falling blade to the side.

name: Stabbing Fall
description: Dive the tip straight down through a gap in the raised guard with a needle of qi.

name: Deed Thong
description: Lay slow circles of thong on the ground so that a foe who enters the ring is caught in the loops.

name: Ironflick
description: Raise the whip into the open sky as qi gathers in the field then bring it down in one crushing fall.

name: Facetpopper
description: Hold two thongs at either hip so that each sits ready to answer for the other.

name: Blaze Lashend
description: Throw the right thong across the foe's high line and keep the left ready below.

name: Tempered Popper
description: Answer the right thong's stroke with a left stroke aimed at the knee.

name: Gust Keeper
description: Walk the measured pace of the court with the thongs swinging evenly at each side.

name: Sharp Fall
description: Listen through both thongs for the faint shift of weight in the foe's stance.

name: Plaitnerve
description: Throw both thongs around the foe from either side and draw the loops toward each other.

name: Gust Lashcore
description: Cross the thongs in front of the chest so a blade is caught in the fork and slid away.

name: Snapscourge
description: Crack one thong then the other in answering beats until the foe loses count of the rhythm.

name: Escalating Plait
description: Run the first thong high and the second low in a call and answer that opens the guard to a third strike.

name: Dismantling Popcrack
description: Sweep both thongs outward in a wide paired arc that clears the ground of anyone standing near.

name: Granite Tether
description: Bring both thongs together onto one point with a surge of qi that decides the exchange outright.

name: Aegis Popper
description: Hold the thong in a curved ring like the lip of a basin to catch anything thrown in.

name: Iron Keeper
description: Throw two curved lashes that arrive at the same spot from opposite sides.

name: Plaitglimmer
description: Step to one side then the other in a forked path that the foe cannot follow with the eyes.

name: Chime Lashend
description: Feel the two streams of qi in the thong and learn when they are ready to merge.

name: Shattering Whipstock
description: Cut with the upper stream of qi along the line of the shoulder and neck.

name: Thorn Whipheel
description: Wrap the lower stream around the ankles and draw the loop closed with qi.

name: Keeperdurance
description: Meet a heavy blow with one current and carry it away on the other.

name: Rumblefurl
description: Unite the upper and lower streams in the last span of thong so the stroke lands with doubled force.

name: Webbing Flick
description: Spin the thongs around the foe in a closing whirlpool that drags down their footwork.

name: Furl Devastation
description: Pour both streams down the thong and release them together in a broad flood that overwhelms the ground ahead.

name: Thornpopper
description: Stand with the cracker loaded on one hand and the wrap loop ready on the other.

name: Ferocious Popcrack
description: Fire the crack first so the foe turns toward the sound and away from the loop.

name: Ponderous Flick
description: Throw the wrap loop in the instant the foe flinches and close it at once.

name: Blinding Whiptail
description: Step across the foe's line as one hand ends a crack and the other begins a wrap.

name: Clairvoyant Thong
description: Feel whether the crack or the wrap is carrying the exchange and shift qi to match.

name: Tethervalor
description: Use the report of a crack to pull the guard open then drop the loop through the gap.

name: Keeperruin
description: Hold the foe's weapon arm in a wrap and cut with the free tip at the unprotected side.

name: Unconquered Lashcore
description: Cross the crack hand over the wrap hand to catch a thrust between the two lines.

name: Tempered Furl
description: Snap the thong so that both tracks of qi reach the tip in the same instant.

name: Escalating Tether
description: Fire the crack and close the wrap on one beat so the foe is stunned and held in the same moment.

name: Chime Lash
description: Lock both tracks of qi around a weapon so it can be neither raised nor lowered.

name: Berserk Plait Devastation
description: Drive both tracks into one stroke that shatters a raised shield and carries through to the arm behind it.

name: Thong Tenacity
description: Plant the feet like stones on a riverbed and let the thong flow around the body.

name: Blaze Popper
description: Throw the lash in a curve that bends once then flows straight into the target.

name: Torrent Lash
description: Advance as slowly as deep water so the foe misjudges the moment of the strike.

name: Prescient Whipheel
description: Read the thong's curve to learn where the next bend in the foe's motion will fall.

name: Keeperscourge
description: Flick the tip over the edge of the bend like water spilling over a bank.

name: Furl Reckoning
description: Let qi spill from the first bend to the tip so the stroke picks up force without more effort.

name: Gyve Whipstock
description: Throw a loop that curls back on itself like a backwater and traps the arm that passes through.

name: Rumble Lashend
description: Pull low on a snared leg with a sudden tug that takes the foe's footing from beneath.

name: Murk Whiptail
description: Bend the thong away from a strike and let it recoil along the same curve.

name: Popcrack Scourge
description: Turn the stroke three times in the air so it cuts then wraps then snaps from three directions.

name: Ironlash
description: Cut low beneath the raised guard like a river undercutting its bank and strike the soft side.

name: Keeper Reckoning
description: Let qi build over a long count then release it along the full thong in a flood of cutting strokes.

name: Rampaging Snap Havoc
description: Bend the whole stroke around the foe's best guard and land it where the river has turned.

name: Thorn Plait
description: Stand on higher ground with the thong looped over the forearm and the weight even.

name: Rumblekeeper
description: Throw the whole length of the thong outward in one long cast at a far target.

name: Siltkeeper
description: Climb in spiraling steps toward high ground as a hawk circles upward on warm air.

name: Waningfall
description: Sweep the horizon with the eyes while the thong lies in readiness on the ground.

name: Flickscourge
description: Drop the long thong from the high stance onto a foe far below the position.

name: Immobilizing Lashcore
description: Throw a long open loop that tightens as it falls over a distant rider.

name: Furlruin
description: Crack the thong against the sky so the report rolls down onto the field below.

name: Gustfurl
description: Hold the qi field open along the thong and strike a target that only the field can sense.

name: Shadeplait
description: Spread the long thong in a wide net over the field so that anything beneath it moves slowly.

name: Blazetether
description: Gather qi through a long still breath then drop the whole thong on one point from above.

name: Keepervalor
description: Let both falls hang at the sides and swing together so the guard moves as one.

name: Gustsnap
description: Drop both falls onto the foe's shoulders in the same moment from either side.

name: Furl Glare
description: Take an even stride on each cast so that both falls reach the target on the same beat.

name: Chime Lashcore
description: Match the weight of the two falls by touch until neither pulls the hand off line.

name: Tempered Flick
description: Land the second fall on the same welt as the first before the skin has time to flinch.

name: Harnessing Lash
description: Wrap the two falls around the same arm in opposite turns and clamp them with qi.

name: Obdurate Lashend
description: Beat the falls together against a thrust so that the weapon is knocked back between them.

name: Tether Scourge
description: Snap both falls in the air together so the double report staggers the foe.

name: Overlapping Snap
description: Loose one fall to strike and the other to bind within a single breath so the foe cannot recover.

name: Punishing Whipheel
description: Hit the same place on a shield with both falls so the second drives through the dent of the first.

name: Popcrack Devastation
description: Land both falls so evenly that the foe hears only one crack and feels two stunning blows.

name: Aegis Fall
description: Stand with the thong given to the wind and the free hand open in pledge.

name: Decimating Whipstock
description: Let the wind lift the thong and add its own pull to the stroke.

name: Popper Blink
description: Walk with the wind at the back so that each step is carried a little further than the leg alone.

name: Chime Fall
description: Listen for the voice of the wind in the thong and learn what it has crossed.

name: Thorn Whiptail
description: Let a gust swing the tip round the foe's arm then close it with a pulse of qi.

name: Shade Keeper
description: Flick the thong against the gust so that the crack carries loudly to the foe's ear.

name: Torrent Plait
description: Raise the thong into the gust and let the wind bend it across a thrust.

name: Blazelash
description: Loose the thong fully into the wind and steer it by qi along the whole path to the target.

name: Ponderous Thong
description: Cast loops into a strong wind and let the gale spread them into a net over several foes.

name: Vengeful Blaze Popcrack
description: Stand in the full gale with qi gathered and throw one lash that carries the entire wind on its back.

name: Ironfall
description: Stand with the toes near the plateau lip and the thong lowered along the leg.

name: Rumble Tether
description: Time the lash to the strong updraft at the edge so the thong rises onto the foe's chest.

name: Torrential Snap
description: Walk the narrow rim in short sure steps with the thong held in against the body.

name: Clairvoyant Whiptail
description: Hold the tip over the drop and feel the updraft that tells of the ground below.

name: Ironplait
description: Flick the tip upward from beneath the lip so it appears from below the foe's guard.

name: Toxin Furl
description: Hook the foe's lead ankle and pull toward the drop until they must give ground.

name: Intentsnap
description: Crack close to the foe's face so the sound startles them on the narrow footing.

name: Unassailable Fall
description: Lean the body out over the drop for a moment so that a cut passes through empty air.

name: Gyvepopper
description: Wrap the foe's arm and keep the line taut so they cannot step toward the open edge.

name: Tempered Whipstock
description: Throw the thong out over the drop and bring it back in a long curve onto the foe's rear.

name: Shattering Plait
description: Sweep a gust-driven arc across the narrow ground so that all within it feel the lash.

name: Sanguine Lashend
description: Gather qi at the rim and drop the stroke as a falling body drops from the edge.

name: Hoarfrost Thong
description: Stand with the thong across the open palm and speak the pledge silently in the breath.

name: Tetherruin
description: Throw a single cast that is given as a pledge and cannot be drawn back.

name: Phantom Keeper
description: Walk toward the foe in a straight path without turning from the line chosen.

name: Immobilizing Popper
description: Wrap the foe's limb and hold it steadily as one holds a vow through many days.

name: Merciless Whipheel
description: Crack the thong once beside the foe as a warning that is given only the one time.

name: Murk Lashcore
description: Meet each blow with the thong planted where it was sworn to be and give no ground.

name: Keeperwrath
description: Send the stroke the full length of the long thong and a little beyond with qi spent as a pledge.

name: Shadepopper
description: Hold a taut line across the foe's path and let qi bear down until they will not cross.

name: Rumble Plait
description: Spend the whole stored breath in one stroke that is fully committed and cannot be recalled.

name: Hoarfrost Whipheel
description: Stand square on the bearing with the cracker loaded behind the hip.

name: Granite Lashend
description: Fire the crack along the bearing so the sound lands on the foe before the thong does.

name: Ghosting Tether
description: Pace the bearing with a step in time to the gusts so the stance never wavers.

name: Beneficent Fall
description: Listen to the echo of a crack from the hills and learn what lies in the open ground between.

name: Punishing Flick
description: Flick the tip along the heading and keep the wrist from drifting as the wind pushes.

name: Fallscourge
description: Cut along the bearing with qi at the cracker so the report and the sting arrive together.

name: Thorn Lash
description: Follow a crack with a wrap thrown on the same bearing while the foe is still flinching.

name: Impervious Whiptail
description: Snap the cracker against an incoming blade so the wind and the report together turn it.

name: Ferocious Lash
description: Send a hard crack along a single line of qi so that it cuts through lamellar armor.

name: Intent Furl
description: Chain five cracks down the same bearing so that each one lands harder than the one before.

name: Booming Tether
description: Gather the gale into one crack that breaks over the whole line of foes and scatters their order.

name: Facet Whipstock
description: Hold the stance of a stroke held back with the thong coiled and the aim already taken.

name: Sanguine Lashcore
description: Let the held cast go on the exhale so that it leaves the hand without any jerk.

name: Snapglare
description: Pace sideways along the bearing in short steps and keep the heading unchanged.

name: Verity Thong
description: Feel the coiled thong grow heavy with qi and know the moment it should be let go.

name: Shattering Flick
description: Flick a small unheralded stroke along the bearing that the foe does not see leave the hand.

name: Gnashing Popper
description: Hold the aim steady through the foe's feints and strike only when it settles on the bearing.

name: Harnessing Snap
description: Release a loop held coiled in the off hand so that it drops over the foe's shoulders.

name: Invincible Keeper
description: Release the held thong only at the last instant to knock the blade off its path.

name: Mayhem Furl
description: Pull against a snagged foe along the held bearing until their stance gives way.

name: Iron Thong
description: Hold the stroke through a long count while qi gathers then release it along the bearing at the foe.

name: Tetherhavoc
description: Let the held coil unwind in a spiral that lashes every foe within a close ring.

name: Intent Whipstock
description: Chain two strokes on two separate bearings so the second arrives where the foe dodges the first.

name: Gust Whiptail
description: Release all the held qi and the held stroke on one exact bearing in a single decisive cast.

name: Lashend Spine
description: Stand in plain view on level ground with the thong spread wide and nothing behind the back.

name: Flick Devastation
description: Throw the lash high into open air so that it falls from above with no cover for the foe.

name: Meteoric Snap
description: Cross the open ground in long even strides with the thong trailing behind in the wind.

name: Remnant Fall
description: Fix the gaze on the horizon and feel the thong tell of any rider drawing near.

name: Gyve Whipheel
description: Throw a wide loop across open ground and close it over a foe with nowhere to retreat.

name: Intentkeeper
description: Crack the thong across the plateau so the report carries and holds distant foes back.

name: Murk Keeper
description: Meet the blade with the thong in an open hand and slide it past without a clash.

name: Merciless Tether
description: Strike openly and directly with full qi so that the stroke is met squarely or not at all.

name: Downpour Popcrack
description: Gather qi over a slow count and sweep the thong across the whole width of the plateau front.

name: Nova Flick
description: Gather the sky's weight in the thong and send it through any barrier in the foe's way.

name: Hoarfrost Plait
description: Hold the opening posture of the forms with the thong coiled and the breath deep.

name: Corroding Snap
description: Throw the plain opening stroke that begins every form of the set.

name: Gust Flick
description: Move through the fixed step pattern of the set with each cast placed on its beat.

name: Chimepopper
description: Match the breath to the set and feel the foe's breath fall out of time with it.

name: Rumble Popcrack
description: Turn the body a half circle in the form and flick the tip across the rear line.

name: Gyve Lashcore
description: Perform the binding form that spirals the thong around the foe's arm and pulls it across the body.

name: Poppermettle
description: Perform the guarding form that wheels the thong across the front and sheds the blow to the side.

name: Intent Whiptail
description: Perform the loud form whose double crack is meant to break the foe's nerve.

name: Lash Wrath
description: Wind the thong upward in a rising spiral with qi poured in until the stroke is released downward.

name: Thornthong
description: Lay the thong in the pattern of the net form so that qi lies hidden in each loop until stepped on.

name: Gnashing Gust Whipheel
description: Complete the last form with a stroke that draws on the whole sworn line and the wind behind it.
